This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
2. This Writ Petition has been filed by the Petitioner challenging the order dated 17.10.2023 passed by the Claims Commission, Bhubaneswar in Claim Case No.15 of 2022 and Claim Case No.83 of 2022.
3. In Claim Case No.83 of 2022, one Baibasuta Bhainsa was the Petitioner and in Claim Case No.15 of 2022, the Petitioner filed claim Case No.15 of 2022.
After hearing the Parties, the Claim Commission has been pleased to hold that the Claim Case No.15 of 2022 dismissed the Claim Case filed by the Petitioner.

However, it was open to the Petitioner to approach any Competent Court for a declaration regarding her entitlement, if any, in the property that falls in the share of Durjan Ganda and in the very same order, the favourble order has been passed in respect of Baibasuta Bhainsa and direction was passed to award compensation under R & R Act, 2013 against acquisition of land under Khata Nos. 66 and 67 of Mouza-Kiripsira.

4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that in pursuance of such order, the Petitioner has already approached the Civil Judge, Sr. Division, Sundargarh in C.S. No.8 of 2024 and notice have been issued to the Defendants and the case is now placed for filing of Written Statement.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner further submits that since he is challenging the Willnama vide Deed No.28 of 1984 in the said C.S. No.8 of 2024 placing on which the impugned order was passed in favour of Baibasuta Bhainsa and the compensation amount for acquisition of land under Khata Nos. 66 and 67 of Mouza-Kiripsira is likely to be disbursed in favour of the Baibasuta Bhainsa till the Hema Bhainsa @ Hemabati vs Claims Commission on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146250978/
